rule: Use exact versions initially, compile adapters, then commit Cargo.lock. Do not claim this list is a compiled lockfile.
notes: OpenMLS 0.9.2 is the selected RFC 9420 implementation; group provider, persistence and API integration still require T02/T31 compilation probes.
egui/eframe report MSRV 1.95; the selected toolchain is newer.
cap-std is not a replacement for the Windows platform security implementation.
unicode-normalization includes a Unicode-3.0 license component; preserve dependency notices.
rmcp uses Apache-2.0; the ASL project's own MIT license does not replace third-party licenses.
Extra build/test utilities require their own locked versions and license review during T01.
